title: Showcase scoreboard
description: How the showcase is doing, on one screen, from what the tools already write: SLOs and the error budget, DORA, every deploy, and what is not built yet. Each panel says which tool and file its data comes from. A weekly snapshot is committed to the showcase repository by healthbot-scoreboard snapshot.

panels.title: Error budget left per SLO (30-day window)
panels.description: Written by HealthBot. Thirty-day compliance is the recording rule slo:healthbot_compliance:ratio_30d in IT/observability/prometheus/rules/slo.yml, and each objective is healthbot_slo_target, exported by healthbot/telemetry.py from config/slo.yml. One is the whole budget left, zero is spent, below zero is overspent.

targets.expr:
1 - (1 - slo:healthbot_compliance:ratio_30d)
  / on (slo) group_left (description)
  clamp_min(1 - max by (slo, description) (healthbot_slo_target), 0.0001)
